entities.name: Temple of Aphrodite at Acrocorinth
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The Temple of Aphrodite at Acrocorinth was located in a sanctuary on the acropolis in Ancient Corinth dedicated to the goddess Aphrodite. It was the main temple of Aphrodite in Corinth, and famous for its alleged temple prostitution.
